joint_class: C_eta consists of nonconstant full-Walsh-support Boolean functions with I<=eta, max_i I_i/I<=eta, and Pr(F=-1)<=eta

verdicts.label: HARDNESS_EQUIVALENT_PENDING_REVIEW
verdicts.quantifiers: For every eta>0, sup_{F in C_eta} H(F)/I(F)=C_FEI in the extended-real sense.
verdicts.embedding: For arbitrary nonconstant seed g, take one-point full-support surgery u_m of g^{tensor m}, r_m=ceil(sqrt(m)), and F_m=1+A_{r_m}(u_m-1).

verdicts.label: HARDNESS_EQUIVALENT_NEW_PROOF_PENDING_REVIEW
verdicts.quantifiers: For every eta>0, sup_{F in C_eta} L(F)/I(F)=C_L.
verdicts.embedding: The same u_m, r_m, F_m construction.

verdicts.label: FINITENESS_EQUIVALENT_BY_A003_PENDING_REVIEW
verdicts.embedding: Not required: STEP is universally quantified on the original Boolean domain.

verdicts.label: UNRESOLVED_A002_EMBEDDING_PROVABLY_FAILS
verdicts.precise_obstruction: Each fresh activation control z has Delta_z H/I_z -> 4, independent of the seed; hence the construction cannot preserve arbitrary seed STEP statistics.
verdicts.forbidden_overclaim: This does not show that no other hardness-preserving embedding exists and does not disprove STEP or FEI.

verdicts.label: SUFFICIENT_CONVERSE_OPEN
verdicts.precise_obstruction: The admissible representation, incidence weights, and posterior run laws are existentially optimized; activation may be exposed through cheap controls first. No lower-preservation theorem for J_f/I(f) is available.
verdicts.forbidden_overclaim: Universal quantification over F alone is not an arbitrary-seed residual embedding.
